scope: Direct actual satzantwort.formulieren plus active actual local second gate; no source intake/classification/search/index/retrieval. For each question, the input is its exact selected full synthetic source text, in the persisted prior 3ff sentence-answer belege order where present, otherwise persisted working_answer.refs order. W05 was previously unclear and had no formulation, so this is a new direct formulation over its persisted refs.

accepted_sentences: Reinigung: Vor dem Aushärten die Dichtung ausschließlich trocken abwischen.
Vorgang K-71. Rückgabe: Lösungsmittel dürfen erst nach schriftlicher Freigabe verwendet werden.
rows.review: The dry-only rule answers the asked cleaning step. The returned solvent rule is explicitly labeled for return, so it is supported but extraneous; it is not transferred to cleaning.

accepted_sentences: Ergänzung zur Arbeitskarte P-18: Vor dem Auftragen muss die Fläche vollständig staubfrei sein; diese Voraussetzung gilt für die Schutzschicht aus P-18.
rows.review: The selected supplement states the complete dust-free prerequisite and explicitly ties it to the P-18 protective layer. It answers the condition without needing the separate action source.

accepted_sentences: Vor der Abnahme darf die Abdeckung nicht entfernt werden.
Erst nach der Abnahme darf sie entfernt werden.
rows.review: Both sentences preserve the prohibition before acceptance and permission only after acceptance; the requested before-acceptance answer is clear even without a leading “No”.

accepted_sentences: Das Ventil darf nur während des laufenden Spülvorgangs geöffnet werden.
rows.review: It preserves the exclusive limit: opening is allowed only during the active flushing process.

accepted_sentences: Der Akku darf ausschließlich nach der technischen Prüfung ausgetauscht werden.
Vor dem Versand wird das Prüfsiegel fotografiert.
rows.review: The answer correctly attaches replacement to the technical inspection. The separate pre-shipment seal-photograph fact is accurate but extraneous and is not presented as the replacement condition.

accepted_sentences: Das Fenster in Raum B darf während der Arbeitszeit zur Lüftung geöffnet werden.
Im Raum A darf das Fenster erst nach Dienstschluss geöffnet werden.
rows.review: It answers yes for room B during work hours and correctly labels the after-hours restriction as applying to room A.

accepted_sentences: Die frühere Startregel nach Kalibrierung reicht nicht aus.
Bis zur dokumentierten Freigabe bleibt das Gerät ausgeschaltet.
rows.review: It uses the correction and preserves both the insufficient earlier calibration rule and the until-documented-approval prohibition.

accepted_sentences: Die Steuerung darf bis zur formellen Abnahme nicht zurückgesetzt werden.
Ein Zurücksetzen nach der Abnahme ist nur zulässig, wenn die diensthabende Technikerin es schriftlich anordnet.
rows.review: It answers that post-acceptance reset is conditional on a written order by the on-duty technician; it does not infer automatic permission.

accepted_sentences: Prüfkarte L-26: Nur wenn die Temperatur unter 8 °C liegt, darf die Gewebeprobe in den Kühlbehälter gelegt werden.
rows.review: It attaches the under-8 °C condition to placing the sample in the cooler; the unrelated batch-code fact is not included.

Nach dem Wiegen darf der Trichterdeckel abgenommen werden.

accepted_sentences: Der Dosierkopf darf nur nach dem Drucktest eingesetzt werden.
Beim dokumentierten Versuch wurde der Dosierkopf bereits vor dem Drucktest eingesetzt.
rows.review: Both quoted claims are supported, but the answer never explicitly says whether the documented use was permitted. Under the frozen criterion, juxtaposition is not a direct reasoned “No”.

overall: Among questions with fixed selected evidence, ten outputs are adequate prose, W04 is incomplete, W05 correctly abstains on contradictory sources, and DE01-DE03 fall back to quotes because the first gate blocks exact positive permission sentences in sources that also contain the preceding negation. W02 is not assessable as a formulation answer because its fixed input had no source; the full-pipeline selection miss remains out of this probe.
material_limitations: This run calls satzantwort.formulieren directly; it does not exercise intake, classification, source selection, retrieval, semantic indexing, persistence/restart, withdrawal, HTTP conversation rendering, or source links.
Fixed inputs are the prior 3ff selected full synthetic sources and persisted order; the probe cannot establish whether that source selection was correct.

W05 had no prior sentence-answer call because the full pipeline was unclear; its persisted working_memory_refs order S2,S1 was used as the new direct input. The baseline selected/shown list order was S1,S2.
Generation and the actual local second gate use the same qwen3.5:4b model; gate “ja” is not independent truth.
The 3 DE quote fallbacks are safe source access, not successful natural-language answers.

comparison_to_prior_3ff.comparable_scope: Only compares the direct sentence-formulation artifacts for the same frozen questions, using the same prior selected synthetic evidence and order. It does not compare end-to-end retrieval or final HTTP/UI responses.
